ambiguity.detail: Alexander and Juliana's exact dynamic working together is initially vague.

verdict.hook_line: Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A skilled healer and her rugged partner successfully cure a sick child, but their secretive lifestyle is threatened by local attention.
verdict.why_it_works: Visual body scars and a medical crisis in the first three seconds capture instant attention and establish high stakes.
